questions.question: What is the remainder when x² + 9x + 3 is divided by (x - 5)?
questions.explanation: The remainder theorem says the remainder of dividing P(x) by (x - 5) is P(5). So P(5) = 5² + 9(5) + 3 = 25 + 45 + 3 = 73. No long division is needed.
